completion_rule: This template is not a PASS artifact. After review, each non-empty operator_note must be split into triage_items, assigned one allowed resolution_state, and linked to evidence_path before the acceptance packet can be considered publishable PASS.
machine_precondition: NO_GO_INTERACTION_PROFILE_RUNTIME_RECHECK_PENDING: do not start human touch/visual steps until a reset-bounded normal capture proves the quiet interaction profile.

interaction_profile.required_marker: [build] interaction_profile=quiet epaper_trace=0 touch_trace=0 ft6336_threshold=0x70 touch_poll_active_ms=5 touch_poll_refresh_ms=5 refresh_policy=partial_x5_then_fast_cleanup

review_records.operator_action: 在日常表情页轻点上/中/下几个位置，不要长按。
review_records.regression_guard: tap must remain separate from anywhere 3 s menu entry
review_records.success_signal: 表情看向触点并有整张内脸反应；不会误进入菜单。
review_records.title: Daily face tap keeps social mode

review_records.operator_action: 在日常表情页分别左/右/上/下滑动。
review_records.regression_guard: ordinary swipes must keep feeding pet_behavior instead of navigation
review_records.success_signal: 四个方向都有方向化表情反应；左右滑不会进入菜单。
review_records.title: Daily swipes become pet reactions

review_records.operator_action: 按住屏幕任意位置约 3 秒，保持近似静止。
review_records.regression_guard: menu entry remains a deliberate anywhere long press
review_records.success_signal: 约 650 ms 先出现逗弄反馈，约 3 s 后进入菜单。
review_records.title: Anywhere hold enters menu deliberately

review_records.operator_action: 从日常页长按约 3 秒进入菜单，再从菜单任意位置向右滑返回日常页。
review_records.regression_guard: an anywhere direction-locked right swipe exits menu, and each explicit daily/menu boundary gets one clean full refresh after cancelling pending maintenance
review_records.success_signal: 进入和返回各只做一次完整净化刷新，随后画面稳定；不需要从边缘开始，也没有第二轮闪烁或旧菜单/旧表情残留。
review_records.title: Menu boundaries clean residuals once

review_records.operator_action: 进入菜单后在六项首页上下划动，不要点击菜单项。
review_records.regression_guard: one owner-approved static home frame per language must replace numbered menu scroll frames
review_records.success_signal: 首页保持六项生图布局，不选中条目、不切到旧滚动页，也不出现假刷新。
review_records.title: Static menu home ignores vertical stroke

review_records.operator_action: 点击任一菜单项，进入详情页后从屏幕中部向右滑返回。
review_records.regression_guard: press-cue and target-arrival partial refreshes must not collapse into multi-flash full refresh, and right-swipe return must not require an edge start
review_records.success_signal: 点击项先有被选中的 press-cue，再到详情页；任意位置的返回手势可用。
review_records.title: Row press shows entry feedback

review_records.operator_action: 进入 Phone Link；在设备未连接时轻点 Reconnect 一次，并保留串口日志。
review_records.regression_guard: Reconnect must issue one guarded advertising request without disturbing an active link or pretending that a retry succeeded
review_records.success_signal: 该行显示 ADV；串口同时出现 phone_reconnect 和 advertising request 日志。若已连接则显示 LINK，命令失败才显示 ERR。
review_records.title: Phone reconnect requests guarded advertising

review_records.operator_action: 进入偏好页切换中文/英文，再返回主页检查。
review_records.regression_guard: single Chinese or single English mode must stay product-wide
review_records.success_signal: 每次只显示一种语言；主页和详情页语言一致。
review_records.title: Language toggle stays single-language

review_records.operator_action: 完成一次点击或拖动后放手等待约 2 秒。
review_records.regression_guard: 0xCF maintenance must stay post-contact and perceived as one quiet cleanup
review_records.success_signal: 只出现一次低闪维护感；没有连续多次全刷闪烁。
review_records.title: Maintenance is one quiet cleanup

review_records.operator_action: 在轻点、滑动、菜单进入前后观察表情整体质感。
review_records.regression_guard: future art tuning must go through genref_sheet_12_inner_faces_v5 style anchors
review_records.success_signal: 眼睛、眉、嘴鼻、腮线和小标记共同变化；不像只播放固定眼睛模板。
review_records.title: Pet expression feels alive enough for next art pass

start_rule: Do not start this packet until rev53 runtime logs PASS, promotion is applied, pre-acceptance health PASS, a reset-bounded normal capture proves the quiet interaction profile, and the operator explicitly says 开始验收.

triage_contract.publishable_pass_rule: The acceptance packet cannot be treated as publishable PASS while any triage item remains open_requires_fix, lacks an evidence_path, or accepts recognizable stale_generation_content as benign.
triage_contract.re_review_rule: Ask for another focused review only for the fixed item or the smallest touched behavior, not for already accepted steps unless the fix can plausibly regress them.
triage_contract.scope: Every non-empty operator note from this packet, even on a PASS step.
